summary: Invite a list of emails to the site
description: Invite a list of emails to the site. Ignores all invalid emails and no action is taken for the emails that already have access to the site. NOTE: This API is asynchronous and may take some time to complete. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to access the Confluence site ('Can use' global permission).

200.description: Returns object with list of emails without access to site.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description: Returned if the calling user does not have permission to check access for emails on site.

503.description: Returned if API is disabled on site
